comparison.objective: Load, centre, and focus a microscope slide without contacting the objective.
comparison.physical_skill: Slide loading under a spring jaw and precision knob rotation for planar centring and working-distance control.
comparison.success_condition: Slide seated and centred; specimen within 1.5 mm of the optical axis; focus within 0.5 mm; objective clearance never below 0.5 mm. Earlier versions only graded focus. No material-recovery rubric is missing.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests pouring and orientation-dependent screening of granular media while retaining larger parts; microscope loading and geared stage adjustment test a different physical ability.
